record.question: How do I backdate or correct a record?
record.answer: Choose a date and time in Japan time when entering a record. After saving, use Correct this record or Delete. Undo is available for 8 seconds after deletion.

retry.question: What if my connection fails?
retry.answer: A failed record save keeps your input. A failed chat reply returns your message to the input box so you can resend. Check your connection and try again.

session.question: Can I continue after switching pages?
session.answer: Conversations, drafts and AI progress stay across pages in the same login session. Reloading or signing out clears screen memory. Optional draft recovery in Data and privacy lets you review and restore input saved to your own account. It does not restore the whole conversation or resume a running AI task.

ai.question: What is sent to AI?
ai.answer: Review the information and optional attachments before sending. Profile details and notes are attached only when selected. Personal details you type in your message are part of the message sent.

share.question: How can I show records at an appointment?
share.answer: On the support page, choose a period and content, add your questions, then preview and edit the sheet. Print or save it after checking. It is not automatically sent to an institution.
